cohort.app_name: Baby Monkey (going backwards on a pig)
cohort.frontier: CORRECTS THE EARLIER REPORT FOR THIS SAME COMMIT, WHICH SAID THERE WAS NO AUDIO - PLEASE REJECT THAT ONE. Audio does work: an OpenAL wave capture shows continuous signal in both the menu and gameplay (mean -30.4 dB, max -16.5 dB over 48 s) and the maintainer confirms hearing it. Gameplay loop starts and persists: scene renders, world scrolls, tutorial fires, bananas spawn, in-game taps accepted, still animating after a minute. Known gaps: 30 AudioFileOpenURL() loads fail with FileReadError on bundle-relative audio/<name>.wav paths, so that loader is not finding its files and which sounds are missing is not yet established; Chartboost/Flurry faked; only the first level segment and tutorial observed.

cohort.frontier: Regression fixed; supersedes report 46. A tap on the splash enters a level and the game runs: the mouse, the cheese, the drawn route and the HUD all render, and successive captures differ, so the loop is live rather than a frozen frame. The cause was that the app subclasses NSArray, and tapHLE's array primitives live on the concrete class rather than on NSArray, so the subclass had no storage and lost its own methods. Class registration now splices the concrete class in under such a subclass, metaclass included so that +alloc resolves correctly.

cohort.frontier: Gameplay runs: notes fall on all three lanes, taps register and light the targets, score/streak/multiplier update and the audio queue drives the chart. It hangs after roughly one to two minutes of play - the frame stops changing (five byte-identical captures) and touches stop registering, while the process stays alive. Reaching gameplay required a UIKit fix: a view added to a window hierarchy after launch never got layoutSubviews, which is where the standard EAGLView creates and binds its renderbuffer, so the game view presented every frame into no drawable.
